title: Person
description: A comprehensive definition of a human person

Money.description: A monetary amount with its currency. Currency is an ISO 4217 code (e.g. ILS, USD, EUR).

Address.description: Reusable address object used throughout the schema wherever a physical location is needed

addition.description: Optional extra detail: building name, hospital, cemetery, floor, suite, landmark, etc. Null if not applicable.

Other.description: Reusable object used wherever a field or enum includes an 'other' option. Provides a description of what 'other' means in that specific context.

description.description: Human-readable explanation of what 'other' means in this specific context. Null if no further detail is available.

prefix.description: Mr / Mrs / Dr / Prof / Sir / etc.

preferred.description: Name person prefers to be called

context.description: Descriptive label for the setting (e.g. 'family', 'colleagues'). Null if not known.

called_by.description: GUIDs of Person records who use this nickname. Minimum one entry.

items.description: A residence or mailing address with period metadata

affiliations.description: Memberships, roles, and participation in organisations that are not paid employment. Covers clubs, professional bodies, volunteering, political parties, religious organisations, alumni networks, unions, and more.

organisation.description: Name of the organisation or group

role.description: The person's role or membership tier — e.g. 'member', 'board member', 'volunteer', 'chairperson', 'founding member'

description.description: What the person does or did within this affiliation

family.description: Romantic partners and family tree. All people referenced by GUID.

tree.description: Structured family relationships up to 3rd degree, plus extended

parents.description: 1st degree — biological, adoptive, or step parents. Maximum 2.

line.description: Which grandparent line they descend from

siblings.description: 1st degree — brothers and sisters of any kind.

through_child.description: GUID of the child (1st degree) through whom this grandchild is connected

through_grandchild.description: GUID of the grandchild (2nd degree) through whom this great-grandchild is connected

through_parent.description: GUID of the parent who is their sibling

through_sibling.description: GUID of the sibling who is their parent

removed.description: Number of generations removed (0 = same generation)

through_aunt_uncle.description: GUID of the aunt/uncle through whom this cousin is connected

extended.description: Any family relationship not covered by the above (e.g. great-aunts, great-uncles, second cousins, in-laws, godparents, chosen family).

connections.description: The person's social graph — non-family, non-romantic connections. Captures who they know, the nature of the relationship, subjective attitude toward them, and interaction patterns.

person_id.description: GUID of the connected Person record

given_nickname.description: The informal name this person uses when addressing this connection — e.g. 'Joshy', 'Tali'. Complements the nickname entry in the connected Person's name.nickname array, where called_by includes this person's GUID.

role.description: Free-text description of the nature of this connection — e.g. 'close friend', 'coworker', 'PhD advisor', 'running buddy', 'childhood neighbor'

context.description: How and where this connection was formed

where.description: Address of the place or organisation where they met

since.description: Approximate date the connection was established

attitude.description: The person's subjective attitude toward this connection. Optional but recommended — omit only when there is genuinely no assessment to record.

as_of.description: Date this assessment was last updated

valence.description: Overall emotional tone of the relationship

score.description: Numeric sentiment score. -1.0 = strongly negative, 0 = neutral, +1.0 = strongly positive

influence.description: How much this person influences the subject's decisions or worldview

notes.description: Free-text notes about the relationship quality or history

interaction.description: How and how often the person interacts with this connection

channels.description: Communication channels used with this person

residency.description: Full history of places the person has lived. If end_date is null, the person currently lives there.

end_date.description: Date the person moved out. null = currently living here

notes.description: Optional context — e.g. reason for move, living situation

skills.description: Skills, competencies, and knowledge — including tools, software, hardware, professional techniques, and soft skills.

name.description: Skill or tool name — e.g. 'Python', 'fMRI analysis', 'public speaking', 'Figma', 'surgical suturing'

category.description: Broad category of the skill — e.g. 'programming', 'data_analysis', 'software', 'hardware', 'lab_technique', 'creative', 'communication', 'management', 'research', 'physical', 'craft'

proficiency.description: Self-assessed or formally assessed proficiency level

used_since.description: Date the person first started using or learning this skill

last_used.description: Most recent date the skill was actively used

certifications.description: Formal certifications or credentials for this skill

narrative.description: Free-text narrative summary of the person's life

bank_accounts.description: Bank accounts held by the person.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code — e.g. IL, US, GB

iban.description: IBAN — required, must not be null

cash.description: Physical cash held by the person, with a description of where it is kept.

where.description: Free-text location description — e.g. 'personal wallet', 'hidden in the blue shirt inside the bedroom closet'

loans.description: Money the person owes to a bank or institution.

lender.description: Name of the bank or lending institution

interest_rate.description: Annual interest rate as a percentage (e.g. 4.5 for 4.5%)

debts.description: Informal money owed to a person or non-institutional entity.

to.description: Name or description of who is owed

to_person_id.description: GUID of the Person record if the creditor is in the dataset

deposits.description: Money the person has deposited or placed in a financial instrument.

type.description: e.g. fixed_deposit, savings_plan, pension, investment_account, crypto_wallet

matures.description: Maturity or expected withdrawal date, if applicable

pets.description: Animals the person owns or cares for.

since.description: When the person got this pet

end_date.description: Last date the person had this pet. null = still with them. Equals passed_on if the pet died while with the person. Set without passed_on if the pet was rehomed or given away.

passed_on.description: Date the pet died. null if rehomed or still alive.

ownership.description: Physical and non-physical assets the person owns or co-owns. Devices formerly in digital.known_devices now live here.

name.description: Human-readable name for this asset — e.g. 'MacBook Pro 2016', 'Apartment on Rothschild Blvd', 'Toyota Corolla 2021'

description.description: Free-text details — make, model, condition, year, serial number, etc.

acquired_date.description: Date of purchase, inheritance, gift, or other acquisition

acquisition_method.description: How the person came to own this asset

ownership_share.description: Fraction of ownership. 1.0 = fully owned, 0.5 = co-owned equally. Omit if sole owner.

co_owners.description: GUIDs of other Person records who co-own this asset

address.description: Physical location — used for real_estate, vehicles (stored at), etc.

identifier.description: Serial number, VIN, registration plate, title number, ISBN, patent number, etc.

still_owned.description: false if the person no longer owns this asset

disposed_date.description: Date sold, gifted, lost, or otherwise disposed of

estimated_value.description: Optional valuation — present but not required
